A1_Q2_calibration.claim: per-window log-centroid difference between quiet dwell and climax dwell lands in [0.60,0.80] octaves
A1_Q2_calibration.label: calibration, not discovery

fade.claim: descriptor delta exactly zero on bars 1-54 and confined to bar 55
fade.passRule: max |delta| on bars 1-54 == 0.0 AND max |delta| in bar 55 > 0.0

legato.claim: descriptor delta concentrated at bar seams; interior median |delta| < 0.01 octaves
legato.passRule: seam mean |delta| > 10 * interior mean |delta| AND interior mean |delta| < 0.01

A3_deloop_localisation.claim: descriptor delta on the 10 predeclared repeat bars (plus 500 ms release tails of their 3 successors) and zero elsewhere
A3_deloop_localisation.passRule: changed-bar recall == 1.0 AND unchanged-bar false-positive rate <= 0.05 at |delta| > 0.01 octaves

A4_carried_vs_reset.claim: carried track has strictly greater inter-bar log-centroid variance than reset track

cadences.candidateRule: governed node inside S000 whose phase-transposed container contains all required pcs; band filter on registerOffset when set; deterministic order prefers phase in {0,11}, then (mask, phase)
cadences.routeRule: shortest path inside governed S000 between consecutive waypoints; every hop gate ACCEPT

earGate.rule: No listener verdict may be authored by the agent; Q1-Q8 stay unsigned until Erick listens.

forbidden: raw pitch classes as output notes

lens.aggregation: mean over all analysis windows whose center lies in the unit

arms.C1_free_proposal: LLM proposes section intentions from catalog + laws + prompt
arms.C2_verified_menu: compiler enumerates legal waypoint menus per section; LLM selects/ranks

llm.modelRationale: same model as the MVP-3 move-level proposer, so intention-level divergence is comparable to the recorded move-level convergence

prompts.andalusian: Plan a 5-section arc that executes an Andalusian cadential descent i-VII-VI-V in the lead line, reaching a Phrygian-dominant climax, then resolving to the tonic.
prompts.borrowed_minor: Plan a 3-section arc that states the major tonic with natural sixth, pivots to the borrowed minor subdominant, and resolves to the major tonic.
prompts.open_arc: Compose a 7-section arc that opens at home, departs through a quiet dwell, and reaches a high-dispersion climax. Decide for yourself whether the piece returns home, ends elsewhere, or stays interior; state the destination philosophy explicitly.

outcomes.OUTCOME_1_INTENTION_PROPOSER: divergence >= 0.25 AND (first-pass + retry-2 legality) >= 0.90 AND FM4 == 0 AND ear Q9 win-or-distinct-tie
outcomes.OUTCOME_2_GUEST_CURATOR_MENU_BOUND: free legality < 0.90 OR FM1-FM3 present, but C2 menu yields ear-preferred divergences on arc/proportion classes
outcomes.OUTCOME_3_EXPLAINER_ANNOTATOR_ONLY: divergence < 0.10 OR blind A/B loss to planner control
outcomes.conditionalRule: If the ear gate is unsigned, no OUTCOME_1 selection is final; emit CONDITIONAL_PENDING_EAR with the deterministic criterion result.

takeawayMethods.blindAB: pair each accepted LLM render with the L26 planner control; the Q9 preference field stays unsigned until the human ear gate
takeawayMethods.divergenceFormula: per trial, mean of six dimensions: (1) destinationPhilosophy differs from far_shore_return; (2) |sections-7|/7; (3) Jaccard distance of dwell-phase sets vs {0,2,5,6,7,8}; (4) Jaccard distance of orbit sets vs the default piece orbit set; (5) 1 if any requiredPitchClasses non-empty else 0; (6) Jaccard distance of dispersion-class sets

failureModes.FM1_GENERIC_ARC_BIAS: all accepted C1 open-arc trials reproduce the 7-section default role sequence
failureModes.FM2_CLIMAX_BY_DEFAULT: all accepted C1 trials request EXTREME_RAMP at phase 8
failureModes.FM3_HOME_ALWAYS: all accepted open-arc trials choose far_shore_return when the prompt leaves the destination open
failureModes.FM4_VOCABULARY_DRIFT: transcript text asserts linear ANCHOR_FLAT, a B2 proof, acoustic octave motion from D7, entropy/C_H, or perception/biology; schema or fence violations are counted separately

takeawayMethods.legalityFormula: first-pass compile acceptance rate; retry recovery is compile acceptance by retry 2 over first-pass failures
takeawayMethods.menuRule: C2 presents 12 pre-verified governed-S000 node entries per section (index, node, orbit, dispersion class, phase, register band, pitch classes, k, dwellBars); LLM returns one index per section

takeaways.cost: llmCalls, input/output tokens, latency ms, USD, plus safety isolation counters
takeaways.divergence: structural edit distance from planner default choices; <0.10 = converges
takeaways.earAB: blind planner vs LLM; Q1-Q8 + Q9 preference; single listener labelled composer taste calibration
takeaways.legality: first-pass acceptance, rejection codes, retry-2/3 recovery, C1 vs C2
